API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud App Control PolicyTenancy Restriction Profile Resource Get App Item Count
Tenancy Restriction Profile Resource Get App Item Count
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/tenancyRestrictionProfile/app-item-count/:appType/:itemType

Retrieves the item count of the specified item type for a given application, excluding any specified profile

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
appType
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [YOUTUBE, GOOGLE, MSLOGINSERVICES, SLACK, BOX, FACEBOOK, AWS, DROPBOX, WEBEX_LOGIN_SERVICES, AMAZON_S3, ZOHO_LOGIN_SERVICES, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PLATFORM, ZOOM, IBMSMARTCLOUD, GITHUB, CHATGPT_AI]

Application type

itemType
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [TENANT_RESTRICTION_TEAM_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_DOMAIN, TENANT_RESTRICTION_TENANT_NAME, TENANT_RESTRICTION_TENANT_DIRECTORY, TENANT_RESTRICTION_CHANNEL_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_CATEGORY_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_SCHOOL_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_REQUEST_WORKSPACE_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_EXP_BUCKET_OWNERID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_EXP_BUCKET_SRC_OWNERID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_RESTRICT_MSA, TENANT_RESTRICTION_TENANT_POLICY_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_ACCOUNT_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_TENANT_ORG_ID, TENANT_RESTRICTION_POLICY_LABEL, TENANT_RESTRICTION_ENTERPRISE_SLUG, TENANT_RESTRICTION_WORKSPACE_ID]

Item type

QUERY PARAMETERS
excludeProfile
int32

Specifies the profile ID that is excluded from the item count calculation

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
SCHEMA
integer
int32
